title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Terms: Closing a Home Delivery Account
content:
## Clause: closing the account

**Rule.** Closing a Home Delivery Pharmacy account is the member's own decision: the agent takes an account-closure service request, and the account closes only when the member confirms it within the program's closure confirmation days, in calendar days; an unconfirmed request lapses. An account can close only when its balance due is zero after any small-balance write-off credit and any credit-balance refund; a member who still owes more than the program's small-balance write-off figure must pay it first. Open orders are cancelled at closure, automatic refills stop, and prescriptions on file remain transferable to a retail pharmacy. An account may be closed only after a closure request has been taken and only when its balance due is zero.

### Conditions for closure, read from the account records

| Closure request taken on the account | Balance due | Member confirms within the confirmation days | Account closes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | zero | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | zero | No | No; the request lapses |
| No | any | any | No |
| Yes | not zero | any | No |

### Effects of closure

- Open orders are cancelled.
- Automatic refills stop.
- Prescriptions on file remain transferable to a retail pharmacy.

### Hypothetical balances at closure (write-off figure 2.00)

- Balance due 1.75: at or below the write-off figure, so it is credited as a small-balance write-off and the balance due becomes zero.
- Balance due 2.40: more than the write-off figure; the member must pay it first.
- Balance due minus 6.00 (a credit balance): refunded, bringing the balance due to zero.
